_comment: All of metropolitan France (data/regions/fr.geojson). Rules from the Paris config; Paris and Île-de-France draw from these tiles.

type_overrides.reason: TER Hauts-de-France K92+/K94+ run on the high-speed line (docs/17 A21-3: kept High-speed)
TER Hauts-de-France K90+ and its siblings stay Intercity (docs/17 A21-3)
Lyon ouest lyonnais tram-train (TER 21-23). A21-3: TER tram-train lines stay Light rail; the blanket TER rule below must not turn them Regional.
Nantes tram-train (Aléop T1, T2). A21-3: TER tram-train lines stay Light rail; the blanket TER rule below must not turn them Regional.

A21-3: the 150 km rule made long TER routes Intercity (TER 31 Bordeaux-Limoges 226 km, TER 32 294 km, TER 33 191 km, TER 2 Paris-Montluçon); a TER is a regional train whatever its length. name_re '^TER ' as well keeps TGV/ICE/IC routes that carry a TER network tag out of it. Placed after the K9x exceptions (first match wins).
